tasks_completed_at_consistency.name: tasks_completed_at_consistency
tasks_completed_at_consistency.value: ("tasks"."status" = 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" <> 'completed' AND "tasks"."completed_at" IS NULL)

tasks_resume_status_consistency.name: tasks_resume_status_consistency
tasks_resume_status_consistency.value: (("tasks"."status" IN ('pending', 'in_progress') AND "tasks"."resume_status" IS NULL) OR ("tasks"."status" IN ('completed', 'cancelled') AND "tasks"."resume_status" IS NOT NULL AND "tasks"."resume_status" IN ('pending', 'in_progress')))

toy_commands_action_percent_consistency.name: toy_commands_action_percent_consistency
toy_commands_action_percent_consistency.value: ("toy_commands"."action" = 'set' AND "toy_commands"."percent" IS NOT NULL AND "toy_commands"."percent" BETWEEN 1 AND 40) OR ("toy_commands"."action" = 'stop' AND "toy_commands"."percent" IS NULL)
